cases.title: Freeze and verify candidate
cases.procedure: Compare supplied source commit/tree, archive SHA256, extracted app inventory, app.asar, Electron and paired FFmpeg/ffprobe hashes with signed-off handoff; record Windows build, GPU driver, Node/build tools and package variant. Review separate Electron and paired-FFmpeg maintenance trial checkpoints and actual rollback evidence before owner execution.
cases.expected: Every identity agrees; version alone is insufficient; mismatch stops all execution. O08 remains BLOCKED if either trial/provenance/rollback prerequisite is missing; identity alone does not close it.

cases.title: Reserve safe test workspace
cases.procedure: Create a new ordinary local NTFS test folder; inventory originals and protected sentinels; confirm free-space budget and no running app/media jobs. Use only copied synthetic inputs.
cases.expected: Fresh output/state directories, originals untouched; one media job at a time. No reformat, ACL/security change or system cleanup.

cases.title: Portable default launch
cases.procedure: Extract verified portable artifact into a Unicode/spaced user folder. Launch its normal executable through Explorer, without developer flags, then close normally. Repeat from alternate cwd and restricted PATH using a process-local environment.
cases.expected: Real native window, correct version/runtime, usable defaults, isolated state, no tool from PATH, clean close. Native picker not substituted.

cases.title: Installer lifecycle
cases.procedure: After portable tests pass, operator uses reviewed installer in its intended per-user/per-machine mode, records prompts and shortcuts, launches normal entry, then tests uninstall using disposable app state.
cases.expected: Installed bytes/version/runtime match manifest; no unexpected authority or startup/network behavior; uninstall preserves user media and follows documented data policy. Stop for unapproved terms/elevation.

cases.title: Native shell and security baseline
cases.procedure: Open real folder pickers; cancel once, then select test input/output. Inspect existing sandbox/IPC test receipts and actual packaged settings. Exercise normal output reveal. Exercise receipt-bound Open and Reveal separately, using only the owned result; close only test-opened viewer windows. Check original icon, About actual versions, licenses and credits.
cases.expected: Pickers work; cancelled picker grants no new path authority; correct output selected; sandbox/context isolation on, node integration off; no arbitrary renderer path/command authority. Open targets correct file; Reveal selects correct output; playback launch does not prove perceptual quality. Original approved icon/license/credits are present.

cases.title: Six ordinary encoder routes
cases.procedure: Run one short 1080p SDR fixture through H264/H265/AV1 CPU and H264/H265/AV1 NVENC sequentially using preserved defaults. Retain actual main-owned argv and executable identity per job. Before native runs compare ordinary Full/KeepSource canonical argv and defaults against protected golden expectations, including unchanged ArchiveCQ29; retain comparison receipt.
cases.expected: Requested encoder appears in actual invocation, correct codec/output, expected streams and no fallback. ffprobe codec alone cannot distinguish CPU from NVENC. Unsupported requested route is a failure/gap, not a substitute pass. P04 requires exact golden comparison, not merely using current defaults.

cases.title: Device discovery and no fallback
cases.procedure: Inspect RTX5060 device/driver identity and supported cells; use existing injected unavailable/stale-capability tests. Observe AMD/Intel unavailable on this PC without disabling hardware.
cases.expected: Supported NVIDIA cells reflect actual device/runtime; absent AMD/Intel labelled unavailable, not verified. Unavailable/stale requested encoder refuses before work, never silently uses CPU or another GPU.

cases.title: UHD downscale ladder
cases.procedure: Use one approved 3840x2160 SDR synthetic source and produce separate 2560x1440,1920x1080,1280x720 outputs. Cover CPU H265 all sizes; NVENC HEVC 1080 on same source as cross-backend seam.
cases.expected: Exact dimensions, preserved aspect/cadence, no crop/stretch/upscale; independent probe/decode and approved media validator agree. Four separate jobs (three CPU targets plus one NVENC seam), not a new multi-output feature.

cases.title: Geometry boundaries
cases.procedure: Run Keep Source and no-upscale ordinary input; run one portrait/non-square-SAR/rotation fixture only if final support matrix claims it; inspect actual displayed dimensions. Include explicit single2160 output selection on a suitable source, with no-upscale and orientation/SAR/DAR expectations fixed in advance.
cases.expected: Supported shapes correct; unsupported shapes specific refusal. An unfinished required v0.7 shape is open, not passed by refusal. Inactive geometry proposal never becomes an advertised feature. Required2160/orientation/SAR/DAR cells without qualified positive behavior stay BLOCKED, not excluded by a smaller support matrix.

cases.title: Trim boundary and audio policy
cases.procedure: Use 150s approved source: start/end/both/late range and open-end; select precise fields and handles; exercise Full reset and explicit batch apply. Use existing calibrated ranges rather than inventing tolerances. Exercise supported explicit range-copy override and visible packet-edge requested/effective differences as a separate policy case.
cases.expected: Requested/effective bounds disclosed; frame/sample clocks meet frozen criteria; full compatible copy vs range reencode explicit; source intact; no silent FPS conversion or audio truncation. Q04 range-copy override without qualifying evidence stays BLOCKED; precision reencode cannot substitute for it.

cases.title: Cadence and offset regression
cases.procedure: Use retained CFR60 and genuine VFR fixtures plus one delayed-audio sample; exercise Full and one range/resize pair through actual packaged service.
cases.expected: Declared frame/sample/PTS rules pass independent validation; no accidental CFR normalization, cumulative drift or tail clipping. Private acquisition/source proof is not package acceptance.

cases.title: Audio route families
cases.procedure: Representative AAC48k stereo Full copy; precision FLAC range; AAC44.1k and mono only where final contract supports; multitrack selection plus no-audio input.
cases.expected: Compatible copied tracks preserved under copy policy; lossy reencode explicitly labelled and validated separately; sample rate/layout/delay/tail match policy. No lossy output claimed PCM-identical.

cases.title: Remux container routes
cases.procedure: Use approved MKV/MP4/MOV fixtures and TS program/stream cases required by Q07. Exercise normal Remux workspace and exact mapped tracks, with one subtitles/chapters/attachment case. TS program/stream relationships remain required Q07 evidence; absent implementation or fixtures are BLOCKED. Add a qualified positive trimmed-subtitle overlap/chapter-rebasing case in its supported workflow, separate from full remux and refusal cases.
cases.expected: Actual stream-copy invocation, validated payload/timing/metadata under frozen policy, correct output extension/container; no hidden reencode or silent track loss. Container incompatibility gives specific disposition. Q06 remains BLOCKED without successful qualified overlap/rebase evidence; full preservation or unsupported refusal cannot close it.

cases.title: Explicit incompatible and quick-copy policies
cases.procedure: Use synthetic unsupported subtitle/container/ASS-resize case and one explicit omission or generated-reencode authorization; test Quick copy only if final v0.7 build implements it.
cases.expected: No silent omission; supported approved exceptions narrow and nonpersistent; Quick copy default OFF and result permanently says not verified. Missing required feature remains open.

cases.title: Queue and batch isolation
cases.procedure: Prepare two different files; freeze plans; edit draft/global settings while first runs; navigate tabs; attempt stale prepare/start through existing negative harness.
cases.expected: Queued/running argv unchanged; draft requires replanning; explicit per-file/batch precedence; one live encode, truthful mixed success/skip/failure counts.

cases.title: Full elapsed UI
cases.procedure: Observe wall clock at Start, encode and verification phases, between jobs, terminal state; compare service elapsed and rendered Batch elapsed/result. Wait 3s at terminal, then use documented return/reset control.
cases.expected: Elapsed covers full batch lifecycle, not encode time only; active monotonic display, terminal frozen, snapshot/DOM agree within displayed rounding. Return to setup is not assumed to clear history; test actual reset semantics.

cases.title: Cancel and recover
cases.procedure: Cancel once during encode and once during output verification using bounded source long enough to observe each. Wait for closure before starting a fresh job.
cases.expected: No unpublished partial shown as success; all owned child/sink work settles; next job works. If job wins race and publishes first, record inconclusive-too-quick, not cancellation PASS.

cases.title: Close and isolated interruption recovery
cases.procedure: Normal close during idle and active job; in separate disposable run use approved harness to terminate only the exact PID+creation-time-owned app, never OS power-off or unrelated process. Restart same disposable state. First choose Keep application open in the real busy-close dialog and observe work continue; later Cancel batch. In a separate bounded job choose Cancel encoding and exit, await closure, restart and inspect cancelled History.
cases.expected: Truthful interruption incident; no false success, unsafe orphan cleanup or duplicate publish; retained uncertain files protected; clean restart and eventual owned-process closure. Both busy-close choices must be observed while genuinely active; completion before interaction is INCONCLUSIVE for busy-close, not PASS.

cases.title: Source mutation and identity
cases.procedure: Existing isolated harness mutates only owned source copy between prepare/start or validation/publication; exercise ctime-only metadata fixture separately.
cases.expected: Real content/identity change refuses safely; ctime-only comparable complete evidence follows documented warn/keep policy; source-change classes not conflated.

cases.title: Collision and same-folder
cases.procedure: Precreate destination sentinel; run ordinary collision and sandbox race harness; run source=output folder with recognised generated output, then rescan.
cases.expected: Existing bytes unchanged; no overwrite or suffix chains; generated output excluded unless explicit narrow reencode authorization; uncertain stage cleanup refuses.

cases.title: Storage and access failures
cases.procedure: Use bounded injected ENOSPC/EACCES/write/readback faults and locked owned file; nonexistent destination and read-only disposable file. Do not fill disk or change system ACLs.
cases.expected: Specific user-visible error, no false completion, originals preserved, bounded retained stage, diagnostic write failure truthful; can choose valid destination and recover.

cases.title: Malformed media and path refusal
cases.procedure: Use existing tiny bounded invalid/truncated container corpus and path unit tests; normal filename with spaces/Unicode/metacharacters. No live exploit corpus or network-share probing.
cases.expected: Bounded parse/probe time and memory; useful refusal; no shell interpolation/path escape; no outside-test writes. Accepted ordinary names still work.

cases.title: Settings and restart
cases.procedure: Persist profile settings and folders, restart; test corrupt/migration/reset using copy of isolated state and existing test harness; reencode/omit grants must not survive restart. Preparation-only generated source: Excluded → explicit current-draft grant → Ready; exit/restart and reprepare must be Excluded again. Check omission grant revocation separately and saved folder/profile/History persistence without prepared authority.
cases.expected: Validated settings and expected precedence survive; corrupt state recoverable and reported; reset truthful; fresh folder/runtime authority; accepted0.5/0.6 data untouched. Generated and omission grants both revoked; old historical generated-only receipt does not prove omission behavior.

cases.title: Diagnostics and privacy
cases.procedure: Trigger known owned failure, inspect History and review export before saving locally; search export for synthetic PRIVATE_SENTINEL marker, paths and environment secret markers inserted only in test data.
cases.expected: Policy-redacted information only; no credentials/environment dump/media contents; review before export, bounded retention; failed export visible. Raw local receipts never auto-uploaded.

cases.title: Accessibility and constrained windows
cases.procedure: Keyboard-only picker/prepare/settings/range/start/cancel/result; check focus order/visibility, exact slider alternative, accessible names and errors. Inspect640x480, normal1080p and125/150% Windows scaling, light/dark current themes. Record actual outer/client geometry and DPI: old642x480 observation is not exact640x480. Include complete keyboard order and screen-reader accessible-name/status checks where available.
cases.expected: All essential actions reachable and readable without clipped buttons or color-only status; no keyboard trap; selected owner workflow usable during encode. Cosmetic findings separate from blocking access defects. Unmeasured exact640 or incomplete screen-reader coverage remains explicit; old narrow captures do not pass this candidate.

cases.title: Offline and startup behavior
cases.procedure: After dependencies/runtime fully provisioned, launch with existing network disabled by owner or use already-approved isolated network test; inspect app-owned connection observations. Do not alter firewall/VPN/security settings.
cases.expected: No required download/sign-in to encode local files; no undeclared telemetry/private-data transmission; actual warnings retained, not labelled warning-free. Mark blocked if safe offline setup unavailable.

cases.title: Bounded sustained workload
cases.procedure: After short cases pass, run 30min mixed1080/UHD synthetic queue, then optional up-to2h owner-approved representative archive run. One encode at a time; monitor every60s; leave generous disk/memory headroom. Separately prepare a61-entry mixed-file storyboard using tiny owned valid/unsupported/generated/collision fixtures: inspect filtering, per-file overrides, reasons, cancellation and outcome counts. Freeze expected counts before launch; encode only an explicitly budgeted valid subset.
cases.expected: No accumulating child/handle/temp leak, frozen UI or corrupt output; cancel remains responsive. Retain throughput,RSS/commit,CPU/GPU utilization and thermal readings if available; no invented temperature threshold or artificial stress generator. 61-entry UI/storyboard evidence is distinct from two-identical-file hosted proof and from endurance; failed/blocked entries cannot silently vanish.

cases.title: Final review and owner sign-off
cases.procedure: Reconcile every case and all43 requirements against exact final bytes; classify PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/NOT_APPLICABLE/INCONCLUSIVE. Independent reviewer checks P0 and owner reviews product limitations.
cases.expected: No unresolved corruption/security/source-loss blocker; required functions cannot pass by refusal or silently move versions; artifact hashes and rollback delivered; Windows/RTX owner acceptance explicit.
